result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, with clean spacing, consistent card styling, and a clear bottom navigation bar. The main visible defect is a missing image in the first 'Popular right now' card, which shows a broken-image placeholder. A minor contrast issue also affects the heart button on that card.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a broken-image placeholder icon instead of a food photo, leaving a large empty gray area.
issues.suggestion: Make sure the image URL resolves and add a fallback image or a styled placeholder with a food-related background color, so the card still looks intentional if the image fails to load.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is a semi-transparent gray circle sitting on a light gray placeholder, so it has low contrast and blends into the background.
issues.suggestion: Give the heart button a solid white or darker background with a sufficient contrast ratio, or add a subtle shadow so it stands out on any image.
